newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Mobile, dividend lift P. Telecom stock.
newsitem.headline: Mobile, dividend lift P. Telecom stock.

text.p: Portugal Telecom (PT) was gaining 1.4 percent to 6,479 escudos on Wednesday with the dividend payment and sharp profit gains by its mobile phone unit TMN galvanising interest, traders said.
Traders said the share could break through 6,500 today, the final day of trade before the stock goes ex-dividend.

"TMN presented quarterly profit of 2.7 billion escudos and this is a good sign for the parent company as well," said one trader, referring to Portugal Telecom's wholly-owned mobile phone subsidiary which posted quarterly results on Tuesday.
Portugal Telecom will pay a dividend of 122 escudos on April 30 but shares in the Portuguese market go ex-dividend three working days before payment is made.
